label: Finite controls for targeted reliability undercutting and surviving warrant
paraphrase: Four controls in a single-subject, two-content, two-basis profile family. The accepted package is true and lacks warrant in the targeted case, yet thin F6 holds when interpreted by undefeated support for other content. Warrant for the accepted package remains in each of three other cases: an undefeated independent basis, no reliability concern or no defeat policy. The models use the low-assessment branch whenever a concern holds.
